title: fix(kanban): a list view board laned by a lookup loads the rest of a lane's cards with "Load more"

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoEynsd5XL1JYxPkwhkywADp)_

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 列表视图里按查找字段分道的看板，道头计数是整道的（比如 30），道里却只有第一页上的那几张卡（13 张），第一页之后的道和「未分类」道更是 0 张卡，没有任何办法看到其余记录；现在每个「已画卡数少于整道计数」的道底都有「加载更多」，就地读出该道后面的记录。
- 接在 #37327（整道计数、补画越页分道）和 #38112（越页「未分类」道）之后，补上这些道缺的加载入口。
- 只多一次按道读取，读法与列表那一页同源（同一筛选、排序、搜索），不改数据和配置；数据源不支持分组读、或分组读被拒绝或截断时不出现按钮，与现在一致，可以直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes
- `ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.tsx`: `rawData` resolves through the same ladder as before; `boardData` is `rawData` followed, on the board handed one page, by the rows its lanes loaded past it, and the cards, the lane pages and the drag handlers read it. On that board a list view hands one page to, under the gate the lanes past the page already take (`hostLaneRead && flatLanes && lanesFromData && laneTargetObject`, now named `pastPageLanes`) and only while the grouped read answered counts, every lane whose cards on the board are fewer than its count gets a lane page through the existing `KanbanLanePagingContext`, so `KanbanImpl` draws its existing "Load more". `loadMoreHostLane` reads `find(object, { $filter: view filter AND lane value, $orderby, $expand (FLS-gated as the board's own query), $search/$searchFields (the host's), $count: true, $skip: <lane's cards on the board>, $top: 50 })`; the "Uncategorized" lane reads `laneField is_null`. The rows are appended after the host's rows in `boardData` (deduped by id), held under the question the host's page answers (filter, sort, search, reload key, the page's ids), and dropped when it changes. A read that answers no more records ends the lane's "Load more". A self-paged board (`lanePaging`) keeps its own channel.
- `ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanImpl.tsx` (one line): `hostCount` is read beside a lane page too, so a lane none of whose records is on the board still says "Cards not loaded: N" while it offers "Load more". No behaviour change on a self-paged board: `laneCounts` is set only when `hostLaneRead`, which requires that the host sent no `lanePaging`, and a board pages its own lanes only when it did, so the two paths never meet and a self-paged lane reads `null` there as before.
- `ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanLanePaging.ts`: package-private `emptyLaneQueryFilter` (the view's filter AND `laneField is_null`). Not exported from the package entry.
- `patch` changeset for `@object-ui/plugin-kanban`.

## Tests
`ui/packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/listKanbanEveryRecord-12619.test.tsx`, inside the #37327 describe (the #36871 rig: 70 deals, page 25; acc-a 30 with 13 on the page, acc-b 30 with 12, acc-c "Cyan Corp" 10 all past the page):
- past-page lane: "Load more" offered while "Cards not loaded: 10" still shows; one click draws its 10 cards in place, the button goes, the other lanes keep their page's cards (35 in all); the read is `$skip: 0, $top: 50, $count: true`, `account = acc-c`, the host page's `$orderby`;
- first-page short lane: acc-a loads from `$skip: 13` to 30 distinct cards; acc-b keeps its 12 and its button;
- dedupe: a source whose lane read starts two records early draws 30 distinct cards, not 32;
- under the view's filter (`amount > 9`): `$skip: 13`, filter carried, 25 cards;
- "Uncategorized" past the page: `account is_null`, 10 cards;
- reset: after a load, the toolbar Refresh drops the loaded cards and the lane offers them again; a toolbar search does the same and the next read carries `$search`;
- CONTROL: no grouped door, a refused read and a cut read offer no "Load more" and send no lane read; a board laned by a text field offers none.

## Acceptance notes
- Scope is the claim's: every lane on a lookup-laned list-view board whose drawn cards are fewer than its whole count, the past-page lanes and the #38112 "Uncategorized" lane included. Boards laned by declared options already page their lanes; text-field lanes are #38120; swimlane boards are #37844.
- `$skip` = the lane's cards on the board is right because the list hands its kanban the first page of the view's query (it pages only its grid: `paginate` is `currentView === 'grid'`), so a lane's cards on it are that lane's first records in the same order. The id dedupe covers ties in that order.
- In the rig the source does not expand lookups, so once Cyan Corp's cards load, the lane is titled by its key `acc-c`, as the page's lanes are; under a backend that expands, both are titled by the account's name.
- File surface: `KanbanImpl.tsx` was outside the claimed surface; the seat agreed to the one-line change before the PR.
- Local narrowing: `@object-ui/app-shell`'s full suite is left to `Test UI`; only the rig file this PR edits was run locally.
- Derived local gate set at ef889db6 (1a8a0662 changes only `ObjectKanban.tsx`, so the derived set is the same): `dispatch-gates --ran` reconciles 38 derived, 38 run, every one exit 0, 0 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun. `check:type-check-debt` first exited 3 (prerequisite not met: this worktree's install predated a workspace dependency of `service-knowledge`); after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` it exited 0.

## Verification
Read first (by risk):
1. `ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.tsx`: `hostLanePages`, `loadMoreHostLane` and `lanePagingChannel` beside `keepUncolumned`; `boardData` below `rawData`.
2. `ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanImpl.tsx`: the `hostCount` line.
3. The new pins in `listKanbanEveryRecord-12619.test.tsx`.

Two-minute check: from `ui/`, `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/listKanbanEveryRecord-12619.test.tsx -t 37327` shows 29 passing; set the `hostLanePages` arm of `lanePagingChannel` in `ObjectKanban.tsx` to `null` and the 7 load pins fail.
